info.title: DishPlay pilot API
info.description: Contract for implemented Next.js route handlers. All mutations require a matching Origin header. This pilot provides catalogue, private photos, atomic publication and durable photo capture. Reconstruction POST is explicitly unavailable; no connected worker or native capture API is promised. See api.md for detailed limits and retention semantics.

post.summary: Create an account and its restaurant

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: Sets a seven-day HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie. Hosted/production signup requires ALLOW_SIGNUP=true. Local development allows signup. Five attempts/IP/15 minutes.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: Sets the session cookie. Persistent 15-minute limits: 50 attempts/IP, 10/IP+email, 30/email. Password whitespace is significant.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: Clears the cookie; succeeds when no session cookie is supplied. No JSON body is required.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

delete.description: Stale version returns 409. A dish with any saved captures returns 409 HAS_SAVED_CAPTURES; mark unavailable to retain originals.

post.summary: Atomically publish the current menu version

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: Requires at least one available dish and the current restaurant version. Freezes available dishes, categories and restaurant metadata in one transaction. Repeating the same current version is idempotent. Previously published image grants are retained.

get.summary: Read the latest public menu snapshot

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

get.description: 404 before publication. Slug demo returns the independent read-only fixture without a database. Draft changes remain private until publication.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: SHA-256 deduplication within the restaurant. 100 MiB total distinct image bytes/restaurant. Stores exact bytes in the database; no object-store or re-encode step.

requestBody.description: Raw file bytes; not multipart. Maximum 3 MiB, 24 MP, 10000 pixels/side. PNG/JPEG/WebP signature, dimensions and container checks are applied.

get.summary: Read an owned or previously published image

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

200.description: Original image bytes. ETag is the content SHA-256.

get.description: Public only when the exact asset is referenced by a retained published snapshot. Otherwise the session must own the asset; unauthorized access returns 404. Public immutable images cache for one year; private images use no-store.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

get.description: Newest 100 captures for the authenticated restaurant, optionally filtered by dish.

post.summary: Start a capture linked to an owned dish

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: At most ten captures in capturing state per restaurant. Does not open the device camera or start a reconstruction job.

get.summary: Read or download the capture manifest

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

get.description: Contains authenticated media URLs and SHA-256 hashes. The JSON download does not embed the photo bytes. Browser-upload metadata is currently an empty object.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Presence adds an attachment Content-Disposition header.

delete.summary: Cancel an open capture while retaining originals

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

delete.description: Capturing becomes cancelled; repeated cancellation succeeds. Finalized inputs cannot be cancelled here and return 409 SCAN_FINALIZED.

post.summary: Upload or retry one complete capture photo

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: Requires capturing state. Up to 150 distinct frames. Same bytes return the same frame ID and duplicate=true. Individual-file resume is supported; byte-range/chunk resume is not. Finalized or cancelled captures reject every frame upload with 409.

parameters.name: X-Content-SHA256
parameters.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256; mismatch returns 400 without storage.

requestBody.description: Raw file bytes; not multipart. Maximum 3 MiB, 24 MP, 10000 pixels/side. PNG/JPEG/WebP signature, dimensions and container checks are applied.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

post.description: At least three distinct frames are required; this is not a reconstruction quality threshold. Stores a hash of the sorted frame hashes and moves capturing to finalized. Repeating finalization returns the same manifest hash. Cancelled capture returns 409. Does not enqueue reconstruction.

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

get.description: Newest 100 records for the authenticated restaurant. No connected worker consumer exists, so the normal pilot response is an empty list. No fabricated progress is returned.

post.summary: Report that reconstruction is not connected

default.description: Error response; see docs/api.md for status/code meanings.

503.description: Worker bridge unavailable; error code WORKER_UNAVAILABLE

post.description: Always returns 503 WORKER_UNAVAILABLE after authentication. Does not parse a job request, enqueue work, change the current model or remove photos.

sessionCookie.name: dishplay_session
sessionCookie.description: Seven-day server-side session; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on Vercel/production except explicitly configured local production.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal the destination origin (validated Host header plus request URL protocol) or configured NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL origin. Missing/mismatched origin returns 403 even for signup/login. Forwarded-host headers are not trusted.
